shellCommands.command: git ls-files | head -100 && cat package.json 2>/dev/null && cat CLAUDE.md README* 2>/dev/null | head -50
cat src/App.tsx src/main.tsx index.html vite.config.ts tsconfig.json .gitignore; ls node_modules | head -50; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit && ls; ls build/esm/components/theme 2>/dev/null; grep -o -- '--g-color-[a-z0-9-]*' styles/styles.css | sort -u | grep -E 'text-(primary|secondary|complementary|hint)|line-generic|base-background|base-float|private-(blue|orange|green|purple|red|yellow|cool-grey)-[0-9]+-solid' | head -80

cat build/esm/components/theme/useThemeType.d.ts build/esm/components/theme/types.d.ts build/esm/components/theme/getThemeType.js; grep -n "useThemeType\|useTheme\b" build/esm/index.d.ts build/esm/components/theme/index.d.ts | head; grep -oE '\.g-root_theme_(light|dark)[^{]*\{[^}]*' styles/styles.css | grep -oE '(g-root_theme_[a-z-]+|--g-color-(base-background|text-(primary|secondary|complementary|hint)|line-generic|line-generic-solid|base-float|line-generic-accent):[^;]+)' | head -60

S=/tmp/claude-1000/bundled-skills/2.1.312/00bafcfd17c86a083078e55677845021/dataviz/scripts; node $S/validate_palette.js "#2a78d6,#eb6834" --mode light --surface "#ffffff"; node $S/validate_palette.js "#3987e5,#d95926" --mode dark --surface "#221d22"; node $S/validate_palette.js "#3987e5,#d95926" --mode dark --surface "#121112"

grep -oE '\b(Table|SegmentedRadioGroup|Card|Text|Flex)\b' build/esm/index.d.ts build/esm/components/index.d.ts | sort -u; sed -n 1,80p build/esm/components/Table/Table.d.ts | grep -n "interface\|data\|columns\|name\|align\|id:" | head -30; grep -oE -- '--g-(shadow|text-body-font-family|border-radius-[a-z]+)[a-z-]*' styles/styles.css | sort -u | head

S=/tmp/claude-1000/bundled-skills/2.1.312/00bafcfd17c86a083078e55677845021/dataviz/scripts; node $S/validate_palette.js "#2a78d6,#eb6834,#1baf7a,#eda100,#e87ba4,#008300,#6250d6,#e34948" --mode light --surface "#ffffff" | head -8; node $S/validate_palette.js "#3987e5,#d95926,#199e70,#c98500,#d55181,#008300,#9085e9,#e66767" --mode dark --surface "#221d22" | head -8

cd /home/sandbox/workspace && npm run build 2>&1 | tail -15; ls node_modules/.bin | grep -iE 'playwright|puppeteer'; which chromium chromium-browser google-chrome 2>/dev/null; ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright 2>/dev/null
cd /home/sandbox/workspace && ls node_modules | grep -iE 'jsdom|happy-dom|testing-library'; git status --short

rm -rf dist && sed -i "s/const MARGIN = { top: 12, right: 96,/const MARGIN = { top: 12, right: 112,/; s/style={{ display: 'block', overflow: 'visible', outline: 'none' }}/style={{ display: 'block', overflow: 'visible' }}/" src/ThemedLineChart.tsx && grep -n "MARGIN = \|display: 'block'" src/ThemedLineChart.tsx && npx tsc --noEmit && echo TSC_OK
